en: Storage → Take the sword. Leave (Esc) and right click on the Armory; inside, click on the counter → Sell.

en: Winter is the campaign: visit families, bribe a voter or defame a rival from their sheet, or give a speech in the street. Townsfolk of titled families vote for whom they like more, with more reputation and a better campaign; offended or angry ones never vote for you

en: An office pays a salary every day. The market inspector can move the price of an item 10 % for two days or fine a merchant; the tax collector sets the tax on sales (5-15 %)

en: Win witnesses before the hearing: convince (rhetoric), bribe (gold; they may denounce you) or threaten (martial; if it fails, against you). The accuser's proofs show at the hearing.
es: Gana testigos antes de la vista: convence (retórica), soborna (oro; puede denunciarte) o amenaza (arte marcial; si falla, en contra). Las pruebas del acusador se ven en la vista.

en: Hearing: question each witness against you (rhetoric against their empathy: if it works their word does not count, if not it counts double) and rest the defense.
es: Vista oral: interroga a cada testigo en contra (retórica contra su empatía: si sale bien su palabra no cuenta; si sale mal cuenta doble) y concluye la defensa.

en: A Secrets inspection, a bribe found out or an accusation takes you to court. You have a season (2 days) to work the witnesses: convince, bribe or threaten them in person (J opens the trial)
es: Una inspección de Secretos, un soborno descubierto o una acusación te llevan a juicio. Tienes una estación (2 días) para trabajar a los testigos: convéncelos, sobórnalos o amenázalos en persona (J abre el juicio)

en: At the hearing the game pauses: question the witnesses against you and rest. Defense = rhetoric×2 + witnesses for×15 + reputation×0,1 against rhetoric×2 + witnesses against×15 + proofs×20. Guilty: a fine, confiscated goods, office and title, or a year of banishment
es: En la vista oral el juego se pausa: interroga a los testigos en contra y concluye. Defensa = retórica×2 + testigos a favor×15 + reputación×0,1 contra retórica×2 + en contra×15 + pruebas×20. Culpable: multa, mercancía confiscada, cargo y título, o un año de destierro
